answer: Duplicating identities requires sourcing additional tokens, and each new token triggers a ripple of network-wide validation fees plus escalating energy costs, making mass fake accounts economically irrational since the marginal cost of a forged identity exceeds its expected reward. Sybil resistance here relies on proof-of-work tied to a physical artifact: each agent must submit a unique basalt token mined from a registered mesa quarry, embedding a verifiable mineral signature. In practice, Agent0040 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
